description.en: Tap or fling the front photo to the back of a tilted stack as the other cards step forward.
description.zh: 点按或甩动最前面的照片，让它退到队尾，其余卡片顺势前移。

keywords: 拖甩 照片 叠放 堆叠 卡片 轮播 橡皮筋 photo stack swipe fling card swap

discovery.caveat: 默认四张内嵌照片，可换图。自动切换默认关闭。

source.implementation: User-provided CardSwap React snippet adapted to a shared DOM core with six native framework entries.
source.license: No upstream author or code license was supplied. The bundled demonstration photos were generated for this adaptation.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Click or fling the front card. Enter and Space also swap it. Turn on Auto to cycle the stack.
instructions.zh: 点按或甩动最前面的卡片，也可用 Enter 或空格切换。勾选 Auto 开启自动切换。
